profile.headline: Collaborative Software Engineer | Building Reliable Solutions Through Curiosity, Continuous Learning, and Teamwork
profile.jobTitle: Web Developer | Flutter App Developer | Retail Entrepreneur
profile.summary:
I’m a lifelong learner who genuinely enjoys learning new things—and then learning them even better. I’m a self-taught developer with experience in Java, C, Python, JavaScript, MySql, Postgres, JDBC, HTML, CSS, Maven, Eclipse, Git, Spring, Bootstrap, IntelliJ, Atom, VSCode,  MVC Frameworks, and Object Oriented Design.  I’ve been fortunate to grow with the support of the CoderGirl and 1904labs communities.

As both a former teacher and a perpetual student, I understand the value of curiosity and continuous learning. I am currently learning Flutter/Dart and doing some vibe coding.

Before this round of tech, I led a varied and rewarding life that built a strong foundation of transferable skills. I’ve started a homeschool support group, developed my own curriculum, and helped students move from hating math to—at minimum—being neutral about it (a win in some cases). I’ve also been part of a team that developed one of the first PC-based tax programs and even led a backstage crew of middle and high school students for a theatrical production. My official title there? Stagehand Wrangler.

I bring curiosity, adaptability, and a sense of humor to everything I do—and I’m always excited to learn what’s next.

Specialties: Java, Spring Boot, REST Apis, OpenApi, Junit, Mockito, and translating “Engineer” to management and users, cross-team collaboration, communication, and team building.

positions.title: Web Developer | Flutter App Developer | Retail Entrepreneur
positions.locationName: St. Louis City County, Missouri, United States · Remote
positions.description:
I design, build, and maintain custom websites for clients, providing ongoing updates, technical support, and digital solutions that help businesses maintain a strong online presence.

I am also developing two cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter, managing the full development process from design and functionality to testing and deployment.

In addition to web and app development, I create and produce unique merchandise for collectors of vintage kitchenware and curate an antique mall booth featuring vintage and collectible kitchen items. I manage merchandising, inventory, booth presentation, and customer engagement to create an enjoyable shopping experience for collectors and enthusiasts.

positions.description: Working in Java and Spring working on permissions microservices app.

positions.description: Writing Java with Spring and React, using Postgres and Oracle Dbs, moving things to AWS.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Unit Testing · Bitbucket · React.js · Jenkins · Splunk · RESTful WebServices · JavaScript · REST APIs · PostgreSQL · Debugging · Code Review · Java · API Development

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description: Writing, modifying, debugging, and testing Java code base that uses Spring, SpringBoot, Maria Db, Jenkins, Bamboo, GCP, and Tomcat. This is a large, flexible code base that helps lenders determine applicant credit worthiness using the lender’s own custom requirements. Agile, Jira, and Kanban are also used for project management.
positions.insights: Skills: Unit Testing · RESTful WebServices · REST APIs · Debugging · Code Review · API Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Have worked on numerous projects using technologies such as: Spring Boot, Spring Batch, Java, Oracle dB, Postgres, Sql Server, python, React, Java script, Micronaut, AWS, and GCP.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Unit Testing · RESTful WebServices · REST APIs · Debugging · Code Review · API Development

positions.description: Learned full stack development using Java, MySQL, Bootstrap, JDBC, Servlets, JSP. Spring, and Eclipse.

positions.title: Student
positions.description: Learned JavaScript with some of the JavaScript experts at 1904labs using the Eloquent JavaScript book.

positions.title: Teacher
positions.description:
Teaching my 5 children beginning September 1996. All five have graduated and the four of them who wanted to go to college went on to college.
I have also taught classes at various homeschool learning centers and coops and have tutored numerous other students.

positions.title: Adjuct Professor of Mathematics
positions.description: Taught prealgebra (math level of kindergarten through eighth grade) to students who mostly hated math. I tried to make the subject relevant, understandable, and possibly even fun for my students. I consistently had a student rating of 4.5 out of a possible 5.

positions.title: Founder and Leader
positions.description: Founded and led H.E.L.P.S (Homeschoolers Encouraging, Learning, and Providing Support) homeschool group. Contacted and booked speakers; planned events, field trips, fundraisers; counselled new and lesser experienced home schoolers. This group grew from 5 families to over 40 families while I was leading. It is currently over 150 families.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and maintained a variety of software. Created AI expert systems by gathering the expertise from employees in the machine shop and translating it to a computer system. Also maintained CADD, the proprietary McDonnell Douglas cad system. Developed a raster graphics representation of the F-15 wing on a Sun mini computer.

positions.title: Senior Programmer
positions.description: Developed and maintained code for automated tax system for corporations. Worked with tax accounts on the changes needed and implemented them into the system for the new tax year. Developed one of the first pc based tax software for corporations using the C language.
